text:
If you're under 30, you're blowing your best years.

As a man, you peak around 35. Not 21. But only if you build something real before you get there.

The bare minimum for your twenties:

1. Lift 4 times a week, no excuses
2. Learn a skill that makes real money
3. Save like your future depends on it
4. Become someone people respect, not just like
5. Read 1 book a month instead of scrolling

Most men coast and wonder why 30 feels empty.

Coast now, peak never. Build now, peak forever.
caption:
Self improvement in your twenties isn't optional. It's what separates men who peak from men who never do.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
